# Cover Letter for Mid-Level Data Analyst, Fintech Remote Role

I’m a data analyst with 4 years of experience turning complex business questions into measurable outcomes, and I’m excited to apply for the remote Data Analyst role at your fintech company. My background spans SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, and A/B testing, with a strong focus on using data to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and revenue performance.

In my current role in retail analytics, I’ve built dashboards and automated reporting workflows that reduced manual analysis time by 35% and improved decision-making speed for cross-functional teams. I’ve also led experimentation efforts that increased campaign conversion by 12% through clearer segmentation and test design. Beyond reporting, I enjoy digging into root causes, translating findings into action, and partnering with stakeholders to make sure insights lead to real business change.

What makes this opportunity especially compelling is the chance to bring that same analytical discipline into fintech. I’m intentionally making a transition from retail analytics to a financial technology environment because I want to apply my skills to products that directly affect how people manage, move, and grow their money. I’m comfortable working in fast-moving, data-driven environments where precision, trust, and thoughtful prioritization matter.

I would bring a strong mix of technical execution and business thinking to your team. My experience with SQL and Python supports deep analysis and automation, while Tableau and Excel help me communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. I also have hands-on experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, which I know is valuable in fintech for product optimization, onboarding, and retention.

I’m targeting compensation in the $95,000–$110,000 USD range, aligned with my experience and the value I can contribute in a remote, high-impact role. I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how my analytics background and transition into fintech can support your team’s goals.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your organization.

## Shorter Version

I’m a data analyst with 4 years of experience in retail analytics, and I’m excited to apply for your remote fintech role. I bring strong skills in SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, and A/B testing, with a track record of delivering measurable impact through dashboards, automation, and experimentation. In my current role, I reduced manual reporting time by 35% and helped increase campaign conversion by 12% through better segmentation and test design.

I’m intentionally transitioning from retail analytics to fintech because I want to apply my skills in a fast-moving environment where data can directly improve financial products and customer outcomes. I’m confident I can contribute strong analysis, clear communication, and actionable insights to your team.

My target compensation is $95,000–$110,000 USD, and I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can support your goals.
